scope: Independent source-only review of CPU profiler execution helper002; no build, shipping, capture, listener or GPU execution by reviewer.

findings.issue: Outer2400s subprocess timeout SIGKILLs only exporter Python; exporter native_process creates separate Cargo sessions and cannot execute finally cleanup after SIGKILL. Descendants can survive, so all_processes_reaped only demonstrates direct children.
findings.required: Keep trusted exporter owned subprocess cleanup effective on timeout/interruption and test an actual long-lived descendant; retain raw timeout records.

findings.issue: Polling for process exit before draining both PIPE outputs can deadlock final report writes when output exceeds pipe capacity; then a valid run is killed by60s timeout.
findings.required: Retain regular stdout/stderr files or drain concurrently while monitoring process-owned sockets; cover output larger than pipe capacity.
